role: Push half of CloudKit session sync: batch selection with exponential backoff, record preparation (HealthKit strip, compress, encrypt, temp CKAsset), conflict/zone/prep-failure handling, zone management, live-backup forwarders and the timeout/no-progress watchdog helpers used by the full sync.
types: CloudSyncError: enum — LocalizedError with single case encryptionUnavailable (cloud key missing; fail closed)
CloudUploadExclusion: enum — Error thrown for sessions read whole out of Apple Health (never uploaded)
CloudKitSyncManager: extension — push pipeline, zone management, asset building, error helpers, watchdog
CloudKitSyncManager.PreparedUpload: struct — Sendable wrapper around the CKRecord ready to save
state: mem:CloudKitSyncManager.pushCycleCounter (private static var, MainActor, in-memory only, reset each launch)
file:<tmp>/ck_<sessionId>_<8hex>.gz (CKAsset temp file, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, removed by cleanupTempAsset)
ck:HRVSession record fields written: sessionId, startDate, isDeleted=0, modifiedAt (via CloudKitSessionFreshness.stampRecord), sessionData (CKAsset)
toplevel: Declares the two error enums and the static push tuning constants; pushCycleCounter starts at 0 per process. PreparedUpload is declared Sendable and holds a CKRecord.

flags.text: Doc comments say zoneNotFoundEncountered limits recreation to ONE per cycle and that pushOne returns true when the zone was recreated, but the flag is only read for a debug log after the loop and handleZoneGone returns false after a successful recreation; each session that hits zoneNotFound triggers its own recreation.

units.does: Returns the localized Settings message for CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable: the encryption key is unavailable and data is never uploaded unencrypted.
units.entry: LocalizedError.errorDescription witness, read by Foundation when error.localizedDescription is taken (settings sync and live-backup error paths)

branches.effect: returns the localized 'encryption key is unavailable' string

units.does: Runs one push cycle: if uploads are allowed and the schema is not flagged, takes up to 25 pending ids (pendingPushBatch), prepares each off-main and saves it, stopping early on schema failure, task cancellation or a bail from pushOne; then advances pushCycleCounter and synchronously writes sync_state.json and pending_uploads.json.

branches.cond: cloudUploadsAllowed is false (sync off or onboarding unfinished)
branches.effect: return without pushing; pending stays queued
return; pushCycleCounter does not advance and nothing is saved

branches.cond: for each id in the batch
schemaUnavailable became true or the task was cancelled (watchdog)
branches.effect: break out of the loop; still saves state

branches.cond: prepareUpload returned nil (gone, local-only, prep failure)
pushOne returned true (zone recreation failed or schema error)
branches.effect: break out of loop; otherwise continue
log an info line; no other effect

flags.text: Writes sync_state.json and pending_uploads.json with the synchronous save variants on the MainActor, while CloudKitSyncState says the sync variants are for callers already off the main thread and async variants are preferred.

pushCycleCounter only advances after a non-empty batch (the return at line 86 precedes the increment at line 95). When every pending session is inside its backoff window, pendingPushBatch returns [] (backoff filter at 179), the counter never moves, and shouldDeferForBackoff's (counter+offset)%period test (216) gives the same answer every cycle: those sessions are never retried for the rest of the process (failure counts reset only on relaunch). This re-creates the 'deferred forever' defect the comment at 195-207 says the counter fixed, e.g. a single recording that failed once on a network error with odd (counter+offset).

units.does: Prepares one session off-main via prepareUploadOffMain; returns the PreparedUpload, or nil after dropping a vanished session from the queue (markDeleted), keeping a HealthKit-sourced one on-device, or classifying a prep failure.

branches.cond: archive.retrieve returned nil (session no longer in the archive)
branches.effect: log, state.markDeleted(id), return nil; else return prepared

branches.cond: catch CloudUploadExclusion (session read whole from Apple Health)

units.does: Saves one prepared record to the private DB; on success marks it uploaded, clears any trash-restore mark and notes sync progress. Routes serverRecordChanged to resolveConflict, zoneNotFound/userDeletedZone to handleZoneGone, schema errors to flagSchemaUnavailable (returns true), other errors to markFailed. Always removes the temp asset file.

branches.effect: set zoneNotFound inout true and return handleZoneGone's result (true only when recreation failed)
flagSchemaUnavailable, return true (stop cycle); else markFailed + noteSaveFailure, return false

flags.text: noteSyncProgress is called only after a successful save (142); a failed save (153), prep failure or local-only handling notes no progress, so a cycle of slow failing saves on a bad network (each CloudKit request can take tens of seconds) trips the 120 s no-progress watchdog and the whole sync is reported as stalled although it is advancing through the batch.

units.does: Builds this cycle's batch: all archive entry ids plus pending ids, minus uploaded, quarantined and local-only ids, minus those still in backoff, truncated to 25 (Set iteration order, not oldest-first).

branches.effect: log that only the first 25 are processed

units.does: Returns true when a session with failures should sit out this cycle: period = min(2^min(failCount,6), 32), offset = stableRetryBucket % period, defer unless (pushCycleCounter + offset) % period == 0.

branches.effect: return false (never deferred); else compute period/offset test

flags.text: CloudRetryProgressTests re-implements the backoff expression in a private helper (defers(bucket:failCount:cycle:)) instead of calling shouldDeferForBackoff or driving pushPendingSessions, so the production function and the counter-advance condition in pushPendingSessions are not exercised; the all-deferred stall is invisible to the tests.

units.does: Handles a serverRecordChanged on the batch push: without a server record marks the session failed; if the server copy is a tombstone and this device did not restore it from Trash, applies the deletion locally; otherwise copies local fields onto the server record (unless the server copy is newer, in which case overwrite marks it uploaded), adds the restore marker if replacing a tombstone, and re-saves. Always returns false.

branches.cond: ?? — server isDeleted is not an Int64
server record isDeleted == 1 and session not restored from Trash on this device
CloudKitSessionFreshness.overwrite returns false (server copy edited more recently)
branches.effect: return false; overwrite already marked it uploaded so the pull imports the newer copy

branches.cond: re-save of the merged server record throws
branches.effect: noteConflictUnresolved with the error (markFailed), return false

units.does: Marks a conflicted session failed (stays pending with backoff), feeds the error to CloudKitSessionFreshness.noteSaveFailure when given, and logs the reason.

branches.effect: noteSaveFailure(error) (may disable the modifiedAt field for this launch); else skip

units.does: Classifies a prep failure: non-archive or transient archive errors mark the session failed (retry with backoff); a permanent archive error (hashMismatch/newerSchemaVersion) first tries to repair a stale hash (clearing the failure count on success), otherwise quarantines the session and saves quarantined_uploads.json.

branches.cond: error is not a SessionArchive.ArchiveError, or isPermanentUploadFailure is false (fileNotFound/sessionWasDeleted, CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable, encode errors)

branches.effect: clearFailureCount so it retries next cycle; otherwise (repair failed or newerSchemaVersion) markQuarantined, saveQuarantineQueueAsync, log 'will not retry'

flags.text: CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable (cloud key missing) lands in the generic markFailed branch and is only debug-logged; the full sync still completes as success, stamps lastSyncDate and sets syncState .idle, so no session backs up while the UI's only hint is a pending count. CloudSyncError's own doc says the message is shown in Settings.

units.does: Keeps a HealthKit-sourced session on this device: if it was uploaded or pending, deletes its CKRecord outright (no tombstone); on success or when no copy exists, marks it local-only and saves local_only_sessions.json; on other delete failures marks it failed and returns.

branches.cond: session is in uploaded or pending set (may be in iCloud)
branches.effect: attempt record delete; else go straight to markLocalOnly

branches.cond: delete fails with unknownItem or zoneNotFound
branches.effect: log 'no iCloud copy', fall through to markLocalOnly

branches.cond: delete fails with any other error

units.does: After a zone-gone save error: recreates the zone; if that fails marks the session failed and returns true (bail the cycle); otherwise re-prepares and re-saves the session, marking it uploaded or failed, and returns false.

branches.cond: re-prepare or re-save throws (any error, including schema errors)

flags.text: The retry success path calls markUploaded but not trashRestore.clear or noteSyncProgress, unlike pushOne/resolveConflict; a session restored from Trash keeps its restoredFromTrash mark after landing, so a later tombstone from another device is overridden by this device's next conflict save.

units.does: Returns a stable per-UUID integer from the first three bytes of the UUID (b0 | b1<<8 | b2<<16), used as backoff jitter.
Runs archive.retrieve + buildSessionRecord in a detached utility task; returns nil when the archive has no such session, throws on retrieval/encode/encrypt/HealthKit-exclusion errors.

branches.effect: return nil; else build and wrap the record

units.does: Builds the HRVSession CKRecord (recordName = session UUID in zone HRVSessions) with sessionId, startDate, isDeleted=0, modifiedAt stamp and the encrypted sessionData asset; throws CloudUploadExclusion.healthKitSourced for sessions read whole from Apple Health.
Returns a CKAsset backed by a protected temp file containing the compressed, encrypted, HealthKit-stripped session payload.
Strips the session via CloudSessionPayload.uploadable, JSON-encodes it (ISO-8601 dates, sorted keys), compresses it and encrypts it with the cloud key.
Encrypts the compressed payload with CloudPayloadCodec (iCloud-Keychain synchronizable key); throws CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable when no usable key exists (no plaintext fallback).

branches.effect: throw encryptionUnavailable; else return encoded ciphertext

units.does: Writes the payload to tmp/ck_<uuid>_<8 random>.gz with completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication and returns the URL.

Creates the HRVSessions zone once: skips when zoneCreated (UserDefaults) is true; otherwise saves the zone and sets zoneCreated; a serverRejectedRequest is also treated as 'already exists' and sets zoneCreated; other errors propagate.

branches.effect: set zoneCreated = true and return normally (assumed already exists); other errors rethrown

flags.text: Any serverRejectedRequest from the zone save is recorded as 'zone created' without verification, so recreateZoneAfterNotFound reports success (and handleZoneGone retries the save) even when the server refused the zone.

units.does: Resets zoneCreated to false and calls ensureZoneExists; returns true on success, false (logged) on error.

branches.effect: log and return false; else log and return true

units.does: Removes the temp file behind the record's sessionData CKAsset, if present.

branches.cond: record has no sessionData CKAsset or the asset has no fileURL

units.does: Forwards a live RR backup upload to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.upload.
Forwards deletion of a live backup to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.delete.
Forwards to CloudKitLiveBackupManager.fetchAll and returns the live-backup summaries.
Deletes a file, ignoring 'no such file' and logging other errors.

branches.effect: debug-log it; file may remain in tmp

units.does: Maps an error to a user-facing sync message: non-CKErrors use localizedDescription; network errors, quotaExceeded, notAuthenticated and requestRateLimited (with retry-after) map to CloudSyncMessages; others use the CKError's localizedDescription.

branches.effect: CloudSyncMessages.rateLimited with CKErrorRetryAfterKey as Double (nil → plain 'Rate limited')

units.does: Races an async throwing operation against a timeout via runWithTimeout; returns .success, .failure(error), or .failure(SyncTimeoutError.timedOut) when the timer wins.

flags.text: Doc says it is 'Used to cap the full-sync body', but the full sync uses withProgressWatchdog; the only caller is CloudDeletionCoordinator's remote delete.

units.does: Runs the operation in an unstructured Task and a poller Task; resumes with the operation's Result, or with .failure(SyncTimeoutError.stalled) once lastSyncProgressAt has been stale for stuckAfter seconds, then cancels (but does not await) the operation task.

branches.effect: fallback .failure(stalled); unreachable in practice because both resume calls pass a non-nil Result

flags.text: After a stall the cancelled work Task is not awaited and keeps running on the MainActor until its current CloudKit call returns; the serializer is released, so a following sync can run concurrently with it, and the leftover task can still call markUploaded/markFailed and save state.

units.does: Awaits the throwing operation and folds the result or thrown error into a Result.
Polls every 5 s until cancelled or the gate is resolved; returns as soon as lastSyncProgressAt is older than stuckAfter.

branches.cond: loop while not cancelled and gate unresolved
branches.effect: sleep 5 s each iteration; when the operation finished, returns within ≤5 s (caller's resume then no-ops)
return (caller fails the sync as stalled); else keep polling
